title: Registration & Check-in
description: Bring your ticket QR code and a photo ID. Wristbands are issued here and must stay on for the whole event.

title: Opening Circle
description: We begin the Solstice together. Introductions, the week ahead, and the first chant.

title: Morning Sadhana
description: Japji, Kundalini Yoga kriya and the Aquarian Sadhana mantras. Doors open at 3:45 AM.

title: Kriya for Winter Vitality
description: A warming kriya for the coldest mornings of the year, followed by a long deep relaxation.

title: Yogic Nutrition in Winter
description: What to eat and drink through a Florida December: ginger, turmeric, and the classic Yogi Tea recipe.

title: Youth & Family Program
description: Ages 6–14. Yoga games, chanting and craft. Parents check children in and out.

title: Evening Kirtan
description: Head covered, shoes off. Everyone is welcome, come and go quietly.

title: White Tantric Yoga® — Registration
description: Course check-in. Bring your own mat, a shawl and water. Doors close at 9:00 AM sharp.

title: White Tantric Yoga® — Day 1
description: Six kriyas with breaks. Once a kriya begins the hall stays closed — please arrive early.

title: Gong Relaxation
description: A gentle close to a long day. Bring a blanket.

title: White Tantric Yoga® — Day 2
description: Second day of the course. Same schedule, same rule about the doors.

title: Bazaar Open Hours
description: Books, shawls, malas and the Yogi Tea stand. Cash and cards accepted.

title: Storytelling Night
description: Longtime attendees share what brought them to Solstice. Open mic at the end.

title: White Tantric Yoga® — Day 3
description: Final day of the course.

title: Community Seva
description: Help prepare the Solstice meal. Everyone welcome, no signup needed.

title: Kriya for the Turning of the Year
Gurdwara Sahib
description: Kirtan, Hukam and Langar to follow.

title: Preparing for the Longest Night
description: What the Solstice night practice asks of us, and how to pace yourself through it.

title: Solstice Night Chant
description: The long chant through the Solstice night. Come and go as you need; blankets and cushions provided.

title: Solstice Morning Sadhana
description: The first Sadhana of the new light.

title: Closing Circle
description: We close the circle we opened. Announcements about next year.

title: Departures & Site Check-out
description: Return your wristband at the Main Tent. Cabins must be cleared by 3 PM.
